title: Source context, bounded company selection and web research
points: The test research engine keeps a shared Pakistan company scope and can select companies before independent sections gather context and stream answers.

A small source-page index supports filtering reported deposits, assets and equity; PSX market capitalization remains as supplied. Initial filing coverage is a partial March 2026 bank slice, with gaps shown.
Tagged-page discovery supplements full-text search. A scoped bank-report pass corrects false statement tags without removing original page text.
Web discovery is followed by page retrieval, with sources and retrieval dates preserved. Empty evidence cannot trigger an answer from model memory.
Full statement extraction, precomputed ratios, synthetic LTM periods and financial-model builders remain outside the research path.
